title: Quenched Keto Polish Cauliflower Dumplings
description: Fermented, fluffy dumplings with a citrusy sumac kick, finished with a quick flambe for a nostalgic Polish twist.
instructions: Steam cauliflower until tender then grate it finely.
In a bowl combine almond flour, baking powder, sumac, salt, and pepper.
Add cream cheese, buttermilk, and eggs to the dry mix and stir until a dough forms.
Knead the dough briefly until smooth, then let it rest for 5 minutes.
Shape the dough into small dumplings about 2 inches in diameter.
Heat a skillet over medium heat, add olive oil, then place the dumplings in the pan.
Cook the dumplings for 3 minutes per side until golden and puffed.
Remove the pan, add butter, let it foam, then carefully ignite the butter to flambé the dumplings.
Serve hot, optionally garnishing with a sprinkle of fresh sumac.
